events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to that legendary medley, what's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting with The Pretenders have given us decades of incredible rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his iconic swagger and voice remain unmistakable.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. More than just an album, it's a timeless call for peace and unity. Which track resonates most with you?

events.title: iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or the Bond actor who defines the role for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its diverse tracks and experimental sound still captivate. Which song stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, stage presence, and the magic he brought to Queen remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Musical Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal shift in their sound. An album that changed everything. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, we lost John Lennon. His music, his words, and his fight for peace continue to resonate globally. A true legend, never forgotten.
